# Spice Grill & Bar

> Authentic Punjabi Indian restaurant at 33 Lewis Ave, Ash Fork, AZ 86320 — I-40 Exit 146 on historic Route 66, about 78 miles from the Grand Canyon South Rim. Open Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 8 AM–9 PM and Friday–Sunday 8 AM–10 PM; closed Wednesday. Phone (928) 277-1292.

This is the full AI documentation, including the complete menu with prices. A shorter overview is at [llms.txt](https://spicegrillbar66.com/llms.txt).

## Business Overview
Spice Grill & Bar is the premier destination for authentic Punjabi cuisine in Ash Fork, Arizona. Established in 2024, we bring the rich traditions of Punjabi cooking to the historic Route 66. Our chefs use time-honored recipes and over 25 signature spices to create a unique dining experience.

## Core Values
- **Mission**: To serve authentic Punjabi Indian cuisine while providing an exceptional dining experience that celebrates the rich culinary heritage of Punjab.
- **Vision**: To be the premier destination in Ash Fork for Punjabi cuisine, known for our exceptional food, warm hospitality, and inviting atmosphere.
- **Values**: Quality, authenticity, and customer satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do.

## Events
Karaoke Night every other Saturday from 7 PM to close (free to join), and a Paint & Sip once a month on a Sunday afternoon (reserve ahead). [Upcoming dates](https://spicegrillbar66.com/events/).

## Payment Methods
Spice Grill & Bar accepts cash, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We do not require a minimum purchase for card transactions.

## Reservation Policy
Walk-ins welcome — we do not take reservations. Phone us at (928) 277-1292 to confirm availability for large parties.

## Delivery & Takeout
Takeout, pickup, and curbside service available. [Order online via Toast](https://order.toasttab.com/online/spice-grill-bar-33-lewis-ave) or call (928) 277-1292. We do not offer in-house delivery; third-party apps are not currently integrated.

## Amenities
- On-site car and motorcycle parking
- RV and truck parking across the road at the truck stop
- Wheelchair accessible entrance
- Indoor seating
- Outdoor seating
- Family-friendly with seating for groups of all sizes
- Full bar (beer, wine, cocktails)

## Dietary Options
Vegetarian and vegan options available, including Shahi Paneer, Dal Tadka, Aloo Gobhi, and Chana Masala. Spice level is customizable from mild to extra hot — let your server know your preference. Gluten-free accommodations on request; ask your server about specific dishes.
